channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Women’s Sports Bar From NU Alumna Opening Near Wrigley Field
item.description: After years in Chicago’s nightlife scene, former Northwestern basketball player Clarissa Flores is launching Level Sporting Club to put women’s sports front and center.

item.title: Chicago Nurses Honor Alex Pretti At Vigil, Outraged Over Minneapolis Nurse’s Killing
item.description: Attendees at Wednesday's gathering outside the VA hospital said they felt a connection to the way Pretti was taking care of others before he was shot and killed by federal agents Saturday in Minneapolis.

item.title: Chicago Summer Events Lineup: Blues Fest, Taste Of Chicago, Jazz Fest And More
item.description: The city dropped the schedule for its summer festivals, farmers markets and other events. The season kicks off with a Memorial Day ceremony in May and the Chicago Blues Festival in June.

item.title: 22 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: Cider Summit, Seed Swap And Winter Markets
item.description: Fight the cold with live music, a comedy showcase, a chili cook-off and a wine sale at Vin Chicago.

item.title: Meet The Immigrant Seamstress Who Has Made Banners For United Center Legends For 40 Years
item.description: Maria Estela Parra, a South Sider and Mexican immigrant, made Derrick Rose’s newly retired No. 1 banner — and virtually all others hanging from the stadium’s rafters — alongside her coworkers at W.G.N. Flag and Decorating.

item.title: Warlord Owners Facing Pushback As Chef-Owner Charged With Felony
item.description: A group that advocates for restaurant workers is protesting the future opening of Lords, a second restaurant by the Warlord trio. The main chef behind Warlord is accused of sharing an explicit photo of a woman without her consent.

item.title: Bitter Cold Sticking Around As Chicago Expects More Lake-Effect Snow Friday
item.description: The city could be in for another several inches of lake-effect snow Friday into Saturday.

item.title: 2 Dead From Meningococcal Disease In Chicago As 7 Cases Reported This Month
item.description: The cases of the dangerous disease have all been reported since Jan. 15, according to the Chicago Department of Public Health.

item.title: Warlord Co-Owners Call Allegations Against Chef And Partner Trevor Fleming ‘Reprehensible’
item.description: The statement from chefs Emily Kraszyk and John Lupton marks the first time they’ve publicly spoken out against Fleming, who is charged with sharing an explicit image of a woman without her consent.

item.title: Chicago Woman Shot 5 Times By Border Agents Will Testify In Washington Next Week
item.description: Marimar Martinez will speak at a federal forum on immigration agents' use of force as she fights to unseal evidence in her now-dropped prosecution.
